questions.q: Will shopping my policy raise my rate?
questions.a: No. Quoting does not affect your current policy, and we only move it if the new option is better.

questions.q: Can I bundle auto with my home policy?
questions.a: Yes. Most of our carriers discount auto and home written together, and we quote both ways so you can see the difference.

services.lead: Gulf Coast homes need coverage that holds up in hurricane season. We walk through wind, hail and deductibles before you choose.

services.lead: A standard home policy does not pay for flood water. We help you choose between federal and private flood coverage and time it before storm season.

covers.title: Building coverage

covers.title: Contents coverage

covers.title: Private flood options

covers.title: Elevation certificates

questions.q: How long before a flood policy starts?
questions.a: Federal flood policies usually take 30 days to begin, so it pays to buy well before a storm is in the forecast.

questions.q: Do I need flood insurance outside the flood zone?
questions.a: Lenders do not require it there, but many flood claims come from homes outside the mapped zones.

about.title: An independent agency on Garth Road since 2004.
text: Whitlock & Rowe started as a two-person office writing home and auto policies for neighbors. It has grown into a team that insures households, contractors and small businesses across east Harris and Chambers counties.
Being independent means we work for you rather than a single carrier. When a renewal jumps, we shop it. When a storm comes through, we help you file the claim and follow it to the end.

faqs.q: What does an independent agency do differently?
faqs.a: We are appointed with several carriers, so we can compare policies from each of them rather than offering one company's products.

faqs.q: Does it cost more to buy through an agent?
faqs.a: No. Carriers pay the agency a commission that is already part of the premium, whether you buy from us or directly.

faqs.q: What should I have ready for a quote?
faqs.a: Your current declarations page if you have one, driver's license numbers for auto, and the year and square footage for a home.

faqs.q: Who do I call when I have a claim?
faqs.a: Call us first. We can file it with the carrier for you and follow up until it is settled.

faqs.q: Can you review the policies I already have?
faqs.a: Yes. Bring or email your current policies and we will tell you where you are covered and where you are not.

faqs.q: Do you insure homes outside Baytown?
faqs.a: Yes. We write policies across Texas, and most of our clients are in east Harris and Chambers counties.
